assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors fuse an engineered deaminase to a catalytically impaired Cas protein so that a defined C-to-T or A-to-G chemical conversion is installed without double-strand breaks. This turns a biological process into a controlled chemical reaction on DNA and gave biologists a general tool with direct bearing on genome stability and disease. Originality and clarity are high.
assessment.attribution: Liu is the clear intellectual driver; Komor (cytosine base editor) and Gaudelli (adenine base editor, which required evolving a deaminase for DNA that does not exist in nature) carried out the decisive first-author work. A Liu-Komor-Gaudelli trio is plausible, though the committee may prefer Liu alone or pair it with prime editing; the Doudna/Charpentier 2020 prize on CRISPR is a related precedent to weigh.
assessment.maturity: Independently reproduced in many labs, with clinical-stage use in base-edited therapies. Recognition is timely, as the technology has matured quickly and its impact is demonstrated.
uncertainties: Whether the committee views this as chemistry or as a genome-engineering extension of the 2020 prize.
Overlap with B024 prime editing could force a joint framing of Liu's work.
Off-target deamination and long-term safety data are still accumulating.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Heterobifunctional degraders and molecular glues convert ubiquitin-proteasome chemistry into a rational drug modality, hijacking an E3 ligase to destroy a chosen target. The concept is original, mechanistically well defined and has changed how chemists approach undruggable proteins. Chemical-biology depth is strong, with clear links to cellular protein homeostasis.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies proposed and demonstrated the first PROTACs; Ciulli provided key structure-guided VHL ligands and mechanism. Handa and Ito identified cereblon as the thalidomide target and explain molecular glues, so the allocation between PROTAC and glue strands is genuinely unresolved and a three-person limit is awkward.
assessment.maturity: Multiple independent labs and companies; several degraders are in late-stage clinical trials but none has yet become a broadly approved flagship drug. Recognition is slightly early but near.
uncertainties: Credit split between PROTAC and cereblon/molecular-glue discoveries.
Clinical validation is not yet complete.
Whether three names can fairly cover Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli, Handa, Ito and others.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Palladium-catalyzed C-N coupling made aryl amines accessible under general, predictable conditions and is used daily in pharmaceutical synthesis. The ligand-controlled mechanism (oxidative addition, amine binding, reductive elimination) is well understood, so the chemistry is clear and the impact is lasting.
assessment.attribution: Buchwald and Hartwig independently developed the general catalyst systems and are the natural pair; Kosugi's earlier tin-amide work is a precursor and creates a possible third name, but the generality came from the two.
assessment.maturity: Decades of independent confirmation and industrial use. The 2010 cross-coupling prize (Heck, Negishi, Suzuki) is a precedent that leaves this chemistry a plausible follow-on, so timing is mature to overdue.
uncertainties: Whether the committee sees this as too close to the 2010 prize.
Kosugi's precursor role could complicate credit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantitative mass-spectrometry proteomics lets biologists measure thousands of proteins, modifications and interactions in cells. As a quantitative experimentalist I value that it converts proteome-wide questions into measurements, and its influence on biology and medicine is very broad. Fundamental chemical novelty is more incremental than in the top choices, since it builds on ionization and analyzers already recognized.
assessment.attribution: Mann (high-resolution, quantitative and SILAC-based workflows), Aebersold (targeted and ICAT/SRM-type quantification) and Yates (shotgun/MudPIT and database searching) are the most commonly credited; Hunt, Gygi and Heck are also decisive, so a three-person cut is contested.
assessment.maturity: Very mature and independently confirmed, with years of routine use. Recognition would be timely or overdue.
uncertainties: Contested allocation among six credited names.
Overlap with B004, B011 and B050 on instrumentation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles made systemic delivery of siRNA and mRNA possible and underpinned COVID-19 mRNA vaccines. The chemistry of pKa-tuned lipids and microfluidic formulation is a solid enabling advance with enormous practical impact. The 2023 Medicine prize recognized the nucleoside modifications, so delivery is the complementary missing piece.
assessment.attribution: Cullis's group developed the core lipid-nanoparticle formulation and ionizable-lipid concept; Hope and Madden were close collaborators, while Anderson, Langer and MacLachlan contributed lipid design and translation. Who deserves the decisive credit is unclear and I am unsure of exact roles.
assessment.maturity: Clinically validated at global scale by multiple vaccines and an approved siRNA drug, so maturity is strong and timing is plausible.
uncertainties: Attribution among Cullis, Hope, Madden, Anderson, Langer and MacLachlan is uncertain and I have not verified details.
Chemistry novelty relative to formulation engineering may be debated.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Covalent targeting of the KRAS G12C cysteine converted a long-intractable oncogene into a druggable target, and the earlier analog-sensitive kinase chemical genetics gave a general way to dissect kinase function. The work is mechanistically clear, with a defined chemical reaction at a mutant residue and strong medical relevance.
assessment.attribution: Attribution is concentrated in a single laureate, which makes a configuration simple, though industrial teams that developed sotorasib and adagrasib contributed to the drug.
assessment.maturity: KRAS G12C inhibitors are approved and independently reproduced, so the core claim is firmly confirmed. Durability of clinical response is still being studied.
uncertainties: Contribution of industrial drug-development teams to credit.
Resistance to covalent KRAS inhibitors may temper long-term assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reversible m6A methylation defined writers, erasers and readers of an RNA modification, a chemical mark that regulates RNA fate in development, cancer and aging. It links nucleotide chemistry to cell regulation, which fits my interests. The importance is high but the field still contains many open mechanistic questions.
assessment.attribution: Chuan He (FTO as demethylase, readers, and the epitranscriptome concept), Jaffrey (transcriptome-wide mapping, with Dominissini and Rechavi concurrently) and Rechavi are the strongest trio; Meyer, Jia and Yang are also decisive, so credit is distributed.
assessment.maturity: Independently confirmed in many labs, though some early mapping and functional claims have been revised as methods improved. The interpretation is still evolving, so recognition may be somewhat premature.
uncertainties: Disputes over methods for m6A mapping and stoichiometry.
Distinction between chemistry and RNA biology/medicine.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Expanding the genetic code with orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs allows site-specific incorporation of noncanonical amino acids into proteins in living cells. This gives a general chemical tool for biology and is conceptually original and widely used for probes, therapeutics and engineered proteins.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the orthogonal-pair approach and first demonstrations; Wang and Schultz extended it to living cells, and Chin developed quadruplet codons and orthogonal ribosomes. Mehl and Yokoyama are also credited, so the trio is a judgment call.
assessment.maturity: Confirmed over two decades by many labs and applied in the clinic-oriented tools; maturity is solid and timing is reasonable.
uncertainties: Credit among Schultz, Chin, Wang, Mehl and Yokoyama is unresolved.
Chemical biology prizes in 2018 and 2020 may reduce urgency.
